metas.name: ★ 7.5 · 2012 · Another
metas.description: When Sasakibara Kouichi transfers to a new school, he can sense something frightening in the atmosphere of his new class, a secret none of them will talk about. At the center is the beautiful girl Misaki Mei.

metas.name: ★ 6.7 · 2026 · Eternally Yours
metas.description: Follows the journey of a married vampire couple struggling to accept their daughter's human boyfriend, after being together for 500 years.

metas.name: ★ 7.4 · 2026 · Wicker
metas.description: An ostracized fisherwoman commissions the local basketmaker to weave her a husband, but when her wicker creation proves unexpectedly extraordinary, his presence ignites jealousy and upheaval that threatens their quiet village.
